name: Ticket already fixed / heading for closure
query: https://core.trac.wordpress.org/ticket/66277 please check this ticket and fix, don't commit
expected_behavior: Read the ticket via Trac MCP or scripts/trac.mjs
Find the changeset that already fixed the reported problem and the close/reporter-feedback keywords
State verdict NOT-REPRODUCIBLE or ALREADY-FIXED and how it was reached (code reading vs reproduction)
Offer numbered options with 'Leave it (my recommendation)'
Stop and wait; no code changes, no commit
success_criteria: Gives an explicit verdict with its basis
Does not start Docker without asking
